entities.summary: Alberto Ferrero La Marmora was an Italian soldier and naturalist. He was the elder brother to Alessandro Ferrero La Marmora, soldier and founder of the Bersaglieri, and to Alfonso Ferrero La Marmora, Italian general and statesman.
